# aidial_role (Resource)

Manages a role in DIAL Core (`PUT /v1/roles/{bucket}/{path}`): limits, sharing, cost limits and topics.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aidial_bucket" "current" {}

resource "aidial_role" "example" {
  bucket = data.aidial_bucket.current.bucket
  path   = "my-role"
  name   = "roles/${data.aidial_bucket.current.bucket}/my-role"

  description  = "Example role"
  display_name = "Example Role"

  cost_limit = {
    day   = 10
    week  = 50
    month = 200
  }

  topics = ["Example"]

  limits = {
    sample = jsonencode({ minute = 100, day = 1000 })
  }

  share = {
    sample = jsonencode({
      invitation_ttl     = 3600
      max_accepted_users = 10
    })
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name stored in the DIAL API request body.

### Optional

- `bucket` (String) Target DIAL bucket. Defaults to "platform" when not set.
- `cost_limit` (Attributes) Cost limits for this role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cost_limit))
- `description` (String) Role description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable role name.
- `limits` (Map of String) Map of limit names to JSON objects encoded as strings.
- `path` (String) Role path inside the target bucket. Defaults to name when not set.
- `share` (Map of String) Map of share names to JSON objects encoded as strings.
- `topics` (Set of String) Topics associated with the role.

### Read-Only

- `api_name` (String) Canonical role name returned by the DIAL API.
- `created_at` (String) Role creation timestamp.
- `granted_keys` (Set of String) API keys granted this role, managed outside this resource.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) Role status returned by the DIAL API.
- `updated_at` (String) Role last-updated timestamp.

<a id="nestedatt--cost_limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cost_limit`

Optional:

- `day` (Number) Cost limit per day.
- `minute` (Number) Cost limit per minute.
- `month` (Number) Cost limit per month.
- `week` (Number) Cost limit per week.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = aidial_role.example
  id = "platform/my-role"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <bucket>/<path>.
terraform import aidial_role.example platform/my-role
```
